name: Furiosa RNGD PCIe product page: 48 GB HBM3, 1.5 TB/s, 180 W, 512 TFLOPS FP8
notes: Product page read 2026-10-16. Peak FP8 512 TFLOPS (eight times 64 TFLOPS FP8), TDP 180 W, memory 48 GB HBM3, memory bandwidth 1.5 TB/s, on-chip SRAM 256 MB. Datasheet linked from the same page is fai-datasheetRNGD-19-v1.1. Supersedes the 2026-10-15 accelerator note that capacity and bandwidth were unpublished.
